quests.title: A Festive First Adventure

dialogue.t: Hmm... Why didn't anyone come...

Traveler! Could... could you hear me out? So it's the Lantern Rite right now, and the Guild was looking to hitch a ride on the festive cheer to do some advertising — to see if we could snag some new recruits.
I hear that Brother Qian's come up with a game called... called a somethingy-screen. I don't wanna be left out!
So I thought up a new activity. I call it... "My First Adventure."
Simply put, I wanted to use some Xiao Lanterns to mark out a gliding track.
Then, anyone who wants to take part in this activity can just open up their wind glider and follow the Xiao Lanterns as they fly...
You'd get to feel the thrill of adventure and take in the beautiful sights of Liyue, with Xiao Lanterns at your side the whole way! Sounds good, right?
I'd originally designed two tracks, but when I went to notify the Millelith, they said that I needed to find a test flier who could evaluate them from a safety perspective first.
You must have a lot of adventuring experience, right? Would you mind doing the evaluation for me?
Thanks so much for your help! Let's go to Mt. Tianheng, then. That's where the first track starts.
This is where the track begins. See? The Xiao Lanterns are all in position.
Alright then — you can begin whenever you're ready. Collect the Xiao Lanterns en route to your objective.

dialogue.sit: Let me get warmed up first...

dialogue.t: Sure, just let me know once you're ready.
This is the finish line. You're pretty good at this, aren't you... So, how did you find it?

dialogue.sit: The Xiao Lanterns were very pretty...

dialogue.t: Hehe, of course! I put them there myself, you know.
Well then, let's go to the next track, shall we?
Alright! This is where the track begins. Once again, the Xiao Lanterns are all in place.
You can begin as soon as you're ready. Same deal as before, collect the lanterns as you head for the objective.
No problem, just let me know once you're done.
So, now that you've tested both tracks out, what's your overall impression?
Great! Guess I can report back to the Millelith now.
I'm sure that a fun activity like this will attract lots of people to join the Guild.
Ah, yes. Here's your remuneration for helping me evaluate those tracks. Please, take it.

quests.description: Tiantian of the Liyue Adventurers’ Guild seems to have been working on something…
